headline: Infoblox confirms SharePoint breach of customer and staff data; Barracuda ties cloud breach to ARTEX; PHP2Shell hits Check Point gateways

bullets.text: New: Infoblox confirms a security incident in which hackers accessed company information, per TechCrunch. The Register reports customer and staff data was exposed through a SharePoint breach. No CVE or attack vector beyond SharePoint is given yet.

Still active: Barracuda links its cloud breach to the ARTEX AI-powered attack tool, per BleepingComputer. Barracuda CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 went on KEV 11-10 and are past their 11-13 deadline.

Still active, critical: a PHP2Shell flaw is exploited in chained attacks on unpatched Check Point gateways (no CVE given). Check Point CVE-2026-123039 and exploited UnrealIRCd CVE-2026-114713 reached their KEV deadline on 11-16.

Breaches: Uber says hackers stole information on close to 150,000 driver's licenses, per TechCrunch. Also on the board: Fandango checkout card theft, Douglas County, Nevada SSN leak, Coles, and Lithuania's customs agency.

Still active: SANS sees scans for LiteLLM/Starlette CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710; China-nexus actors breached 10 organizations in AI-driven attacks (Dark Reading). The Cursor supply chain attack started at Fireworks AI, per SecurityWeek.

Context: SITCON 3 (ELEVATED), unchanged; the last 7 days score 1.05x the 90-day average. n0n (80), INC Ransom (51) and The Gentlemen (40) led leak-site claims, and 300 malicious npm and PyPI packages were listed this week.

actions: Infoblox customers: watch for Infoblox breach notices, treat unexpected Infoblox-themed mail as phishing, and review credentials or contacts shared with them.
Barracuda customers: patch CVE-2026-111560 and ESG CVE-2026-116606 now, review cloud account access and follow Barracuda's breach advisory.
Check Point gateways: apply all current fixes including CVE-2026-123039, restrict management access and hunt for PHP2Shell chained compromise.
LiteLLM and Starlette: patch CVE-2026-42271 and CVE-2026-48710, keep admin endpoints private and rotate stored API keys.
Audit SharePoint and other document stores for overshared customer and staff data, and confirm access logging is on.
Queue KEV fixes: Apple CVE-2024-27834 due 11-18, SonicWall SSLVPN 11-20, Outlook, Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave and Chromium 11-24.
